description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Songs” illustrates how three reported metrics—accuracy, confidence, and alignment—vary across different levels of question popularity. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity” and uses a linear scale, spanning roughly from 5 to 26 with labeled ticks at 5-unit intervals (5, 10, 15, 20, 25). The y-axis is labeled “Values” on a linear scale from 0.55 to 1.00, with evenly spaced tick labels in increments of 0.05. Three solid lines are shown: the Accuracy series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.66 at popularity 5, dropping to about 0.60 at 6, then rising through about 0.67–0.75 between 7 and 9, reaching about 0.81 at 12, dipping to about 0.72 at 14, then increasing to about 0.81 at 17 and ending around 0.88 at 26. The Confidence series is a green solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning around 0.93 at popularity 5, staying in the low-to-mid 0.92–0.95 range through popularity 9, reaching about 0.97 at 10, dipping to about 0.94 at 14, then rising to about 0.97 at 17 and ending near 0.98 at 26. The Alignment series is a red solid line with square markers, starting around 0.73 at popularity 5, dropping to about 0.68 at 6, then increasing to about 0.75–0.80 between 7 and 9, reaching about 0.86 at 12, falling to about 0.78 at 14, then rising to about 0.84 at 17 and ending around 0.90 at 26.
